description: Verification obligations by requirement family. Every matching rule applies (they accumulate). Gates are those of REHEARSAL-ACCEPTANCE-LEDGER.md (G0-G10). Owners are existing systems; no new verifier is introduced.

rules.method: ledger row {id, source_doc, priority, owner, implementation_paths, tests, evidence_paths, status, reason}; verdict computed, evidence checked at its SHA
evidence: acceptance ledger row with tests and evidence_paths at the verified SHA
invalidatedBy: ledger edited without a re-computed verdict (R4-04)

rules.method: requirement disposition and obligation mapping pass the preservation gate before implementation and at acceptance
evidence: praxis.requirements-preservation/1 evidence JSON with input SHA-256s
freshness: re-run whenever the source, derived package or approvals change
rules.tooling: praxis requirements preservation verify (no released build yet: F-004)

rules.method: Percepta semantic contract verification of populated states at the deployed exact SHA; WebKit at iPad portrait/landscape, desktop and mobile; axe accessibility; keyboard and reduced-motion checks
evidence: Percepta evidence JSON (schemaVersion 1.0.0) per screen contract
deployed-SHA screenshots at desktop, iPad portrait/landscape, mobile
freshness: bound to the deployed SHA and the registered Percepta release
invalidatedBy: Percepta evidence from an unreleased build (OD-INDY-2)

rules.method: F# unit and property tests including illegal-transition and forged-history variants; behaviour verification
evidence: test results at the source SHA

rules.method: producer/consumer contract tests at the interface-manifest SHA, owner sign-off, mandatory negative cases
invalidatedBy: manifest revision without consumer compatibility proof
rules.tooling: dotnet test (contract tests); dokimos construction verify

rules.method: three identities match; golden replay of five scenarios; 90 negative fixtures refused; seed hashes unchanged
evidence: causa gate output anchored to causa-storage-v1.0.0

rules.method: four verification levels (PF-011); live create/read/write/reload/conflict/rejected-token against the test repository with independent SHA re-reads; fakes only from recorded responses
evidence: live job run id and log
independent re-read of written commit SHAs
freshness: live evidence from this run only
rules.tooling: GitHub Actions live job using CAUSA_GITHUB_TOKEN; dokimos completion verify

rules.method: PAT-01..PAT-15 (PERSIST-040..PERSIST-055): stateful GitHub fake enforcing expectedHeadOid with real ancestry and injected lost answers, and the live test repository (PERSIST-025); browser tests in Chromium and WebKit; save-state machine model test; production artifact scan
requiredEvidence: acceptance ledger row per PAT test under its own identity (PERSIST-055)
live run evidence naming the real commits it created (PERSIST-025)
screenshots of each save state from the deployed exact SHA (PERSIST-030)
freshness: live evidence from this run only
invalidatedBy: a fake-only pass reported as live verification (PERSIST-025)
a PAT test weakened, skipped or quarantined (PERSIST-055)
rules.tooling: the candidate's PAT suites in CI; tools/validate-r7-persistence-requirements.fsx for PAT-14's requirements check

rules.method: lock compared with installed and loaded artifacts; set qualification; compatibility smoke
class closure: original reproduction, adversarial variants, invariant enforcement, independent approval, SHA-bound proof
evidence: defect-class record with fix SHA and reviewer evidence

rules.method: review against D-xxx classifications; no promotion without a recorded decision (section 6)
report fidelity against projections; print rendering
evidence: rendered report artifact at the deployed SHA

rules.method: deployed SHA equals verified SHA; successful acceptance job on the same SHA
evidence: acceptance job on the deployed SHA
rules.tooling: deployed acceptance workflow; dokimos completion verify

rules.method: process obligation shown by Praxis work items, checkpoints, provenance and measurements; never inferred
evidence: Praxis work item and checkpoint records
invalidatedBy: missing measurement recorded as a value (must be 'unavailable')
rules.tooling: praxis work/checkpoint/provenance; Percepta telemetry metric ids

rules.method: catalog verification plus application load after Connect; no bundling in the application
evidence: application load test at deployed SHA
freshness: bound to the catalog manifest SHA-256 (CT-008)
rules.tooling: dotnet causa.dll historical-verify .; python3 -I tools/py/historical_catalog.py verify . --app <app>
